card.name: Dates and credits in press releases
card.fires_on: The last digit of a year or the space after it in a news dateline, and credit or source lines such as 'By ... Staff.' or 'Photo by'. Seen on science news and press release pages.

modes.label: Year in a dateline
modes.description: Final digit or following space of a publication date just before the next date or headline.

modes.label: Credit or source line
modes.description: Period or the word photo in bylines, photo credits and service credits at the end of a release.
modes.example: EurekAlert!, a service of AAAS<<. >>Note: Materials may be edited for content

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; it weakly suppresses Chinese press-conference words such as 发布会 and 新闻.
card.plain: It marks the date and credit lines at the edges of news and press release articles.
